$comment: P126 multi-site eval — 3 scenarios × 7-9 prompts × ~25-checklist-items. Each prompt <15 words, sequential builds against a clean MasterConfig baseline.

scenarios.name: Hey Bradley storytelling blog
scenarios.brief: Personal blog by Bradley Ross. Three Don-Miller-style narrative articles about Hey Bradley (origin, product, capstone). Visual, dark, crimson, Cormorant Garamond serif. Each article has hook, problem, resolution. Newsletter signup. Author bio.
prompts: Set this up as a personal blog called Hey Bradley
Use a dark theme with warm crimson accents
Use Cormorant Garamond for headings
Add a hero with headline The whiteboard that listens
Add three article cards origin product and capstone
Each article needs a hook problem and resolution summary
Add an author bio for Bradley Ross Harvard ALM
Add a newsletter signup section at the bottom

checklist.desc: site.title includes 'Hey Bradley' or 'Bradley' (case-insensitive)
site.author or related field references 'Bradley Ross'
theme.mode equals 'dark'
theme.palette.bgPrimary is a dark color (hex starts #0 or #1 or named black/near-black)
theme.palette.accentPrimary is a crimson/red hex (#A-D or #E0-FF in red channel, low green/blue)
theme.typography.headingFamily equals 'Cormorant Garamond' (case-insensitive)
Has at least one section with type 'hero'
Hero headline mentions 'whiteboard' OR 'listens'
Has at least one columns/grid/list section after hero (article grid)
Has at least 3 article cards/components in some section
Article 1 references 'origin' or 'beginning' or 'start' in text
Article 2 references 'product' or 'builder' or 'platform' in text
Article 3 references 'capstone' or 'Harvard' in text
At least one article has a 'hook' or hook-like field/intro text
At least one article has a 'problem' field or problem-framed sentence
At least one article has a 'resolution' field or resolution-framed sentence
Has an author-bio section/component
Author bio mentions 'Harvard' or 'ALM' or both
Has a newsletter signup section
Newsletter section has an email input or form component
Layout has at least 4 distinct sections
Accent color suggests warm brand (crimson/red/burgundy hex)
Heading typography is serif (heading family is a known serif: Cormorant, Garamond, Playfair, Instrument Serif, etc.)
Has visible call-to-action button somewhere (signup/read more)
Final config has no malformed sections (every section has type + id + components array)

scenarios.name: Bradley Ross designer portfolio
scenarios.brief: Visual designer portfolio. Hero with name/title/tagline. Six project cards (image + tags + hover zoom). Video reel near top. Parallax hero. Light beige + sage accent. Contact section with email + Twitter.
prompts: Make this a designer portfolio for Bradley Ross
Use a light beige theme with sage green accents
Add a hero with name title tagline and parallax effect
Add a video reel section right below the hero
Show six project cards in a grid layout
Each project needs a thumbnail image and three tags
Add hover zoom effect to all project images
Add a contact section with email and Twitter links
Add subtle animation to the project grid on scroll

checklist.desc: site.title or brand references 'Bradley Ross' or 'portfolio'
theme.mode equals 'light'
theme.palette.bgPrimary is a light beige/cream hex (#F or #E in red/green channels)
theme.palette.accentPrimary or accentSecondary is sage green hex (mid-range green channel, low blue)
Has at least one section with type 'hero'
Hero has a name/title text component
Hero has a tagline/subtitle text component
Hero references 'parallax' in style, layout, effects, or animation field
Has a video reel section (type video OR a section named/described as video)
Video section appears within first 3 sections (excluding navbar)
Has a projects/work section (columns/grid)
Has at least 6 project cards/components
Each project has an image/thumbnail field
Each project has tags (array with ≥1 entry)
Project tags total at least 18 (6 projects × ~3 tags)
Project images reference 'hover' OR 'zoom' OR 'hoverZoom' effect somewhere
Has a contact section
Contact section has an email field/text
Contact section has Twitter/X reference
Has scroll/reveal animation reference somewhere in project section
Layout has at least 5 distinct sections
Beige bg is genuinely warm (not pure white #FFFFFF)
Sage accent is genuinely green-toned (G channel > R and > B)
Has visible CTA in hero (button)
Final config has no malformed sections
Project images have alt-text or label fields
Has navigation/menu section

scenarios.name: Atlas AI Consulting marketing site
scenarios.brief: Traditional B2B SaaS landing page selling Atlas AI Consulting. Strong hero CTA. Three feature cards (strategy / implementation / training). 3-tier pricing (Starter / Growth / Enterprise). Customer logos bar (5+). Three testimonials. Closing CTA 'Book a discovery call.' Navy + electric-blue palette.
prompts: Build a SaaS landing page for Atlas AI Consulting
Use a navy and electric-blue palette professional and sharp
Hero headline Ship AI features customers actually use
Hero CTA button book a discovery call
Add three feature cards strategy implementation and training
Add three pricing tiers Starter Growth and Enterprise
Add a customer logos bar with five fictional companies
Add three customer testimonials with names and quotes
Add a final closing CTA section book a discovery call

checklist.desc: site.title or brand references 'Atlas' AND ('AI' or 'Consulting')
theme.palette.bgPrimary is navy (R<60, G<60, B>40 — dark blue hex)
theme.palette.accentPrimary is electric-blue (high B channel, mid-high G)
Has at least one section with type 'hero'
Hero headline mentions 'AI features' OR 'ship' AND 'AI'
Hero has a CTA button
Hero CTA text contains 'discovery' OR 'book'
Has a features section (columns/grid)
Has at least 3 feature cards
Feature 1 references 'strategy'
Feature 2 references 'implementation'
Feature 3 references 'training'
Has a pricing section
Has at least 3 pricing tier cards
Pricing tier 1 named 'Starter'
Pricing tier 2 named 'Growth'
Pricing tier 3 named 'Enterprise'
Has a customer logos / social-proof bar
At least 5 customer logo entries
Has a testimonials section
At least 3 testimonials
Each testimonial has a quote/text field
Each testimonial has an author name
Has a closing/final CTA section (separate from hero CTA)
Closing CTA references 'discovery call' or 'book'
Has navigation/menu section
Layout has at least 6 distinct sections
Final config has no malformed sections
